description:
When zombie apocalypse strikes, everyone scrambles to survive—but Tae fights to hold the line.
This manhwa recap covers Zombie Revelation 82-08 (Ep 1~143).

📖 Series: Zombie Revelation 82-08
Genre: apocalypse, survival, zombie apocalypse

Subscribe for long-form apocalypse and survival manhwa recaps.

This video contains original scripted narration, editorial structure,
commentary and original editing. Rights in source artwork remain with
their respective owners.

thumbnail_concepts.text_style: Two contrasting stat badges: LEFT fiery red, RIGHT gold/amber. Bold Impact font, thick black stroke.
thumbnail_concepts.composition: Vertical split: devastation LEFT vs protagonist stand RIGHT
thumbnail_concepts.gpt_prompt:
Create a dramatic, cinematic 16:9 widescreen YouTube thumbnail illustration in authentic Korean webtoon manhwa art style. Sharp ink linework, saturated cel-shading, dynamic rim lighting.

[COMPOSITION — SPLIT-SCREEN SURVIVAL INEQUALITY]:
Divide the frame vertically with a dramatic diagonal crack or divide.

LEFT SIDE (DEVASTATION — 45% of frame):
A crumbling cityscape showing the Zombie Apocalypse. Panicked civilians fleeing through dust and debris. Muted, desaturated dark tones. A large bold text overlay reads 'OUTBREAK'.

RIGHT SIDE (PROTAGONIST STAND — 55% of frame):
Tae standing firm with a determined survival gaze. Tactical dark clothing, practical reinforced gear, survival backpack, realistic weapon in hand. A large bold text overlay reads 'SURVIVE'.

[THUMBNAIL GRAPHIC OVERLAYS]:
Two contrasting badges: LEFT in fiery red, RIGHT in sharp amber/gold. Bold sans-serif font (Montserrat/Impact style), thick black stroke for mobile readability.

thumbnail_concepts.text_style: BEFORE in muted grey, AFTER in bold amber (#FFBF00). Horizontal timeline arrow.
thumbnail_concepts.composition: Horizontal timeline: weak LEFT → powerful RIGHT

Horizontal timeline comparison showing the protagonist's transformation.

LEFT (BEFORE — 40% of frame):
A vulnerable version of Tae standing amid the initial chaos of Zombie Apocalypse. Confused expression, basic civilian clothing, no equipment. Muted warm tones.

CENTER (TRANSITION — 20% of frame):
A dramatic visual divide connecting the two states.

RIGHT (AFTER — 40% of frame):
Tae transformed into a battle-hardened survivor standing firm. Tactical dark clothing, makeshift reinforced gear, survival backpack, realistic weapon in hand. Gritty cinematic lighting.

[THUMBNAIL GRAPHIC OVERLAYS]:
Bold typography: 'BEFORE' in muted grey on the left, 'AFTER' in bold amber on the right. Thick black stroke. Clean readability on mobile.
